rubrics_metrics.name: Comedy camp age eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: FREE Laugh Factory Comedy Camp auditions for ages 9-16!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Young comedians will have the opportunity to build confidence, creativity, stage presence, and comedic skills in a fun and supportive environment led by comedy professionals and mentors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parent/guardian presence requirement for camp
rubrics_metrics.description: A parent or guardian is required to stay for the duration of the event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to Laugh Factory Kid's Comedy Camp auditions/attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration per child
rubrics_metrics.description: Please register one child per registration. If registering multiple children, please complete a separate registration for each child.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative requirement for camp sign-ups to ensure each child is registered individually.

rubrics_metrics.description: A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated repeatedly alongside show listings — applies to patrons attending shows. Also notes that prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.
